title: 2016 Wrangler JK with Rock-Trac HD transfer case (sales code DHW): red fluid leak or 4WD noise, transfer case input gear and seal
summary: FCA bulletin 21-012-17 (RRT 17-027): red fluid weeping from under the vehicle, sometimes transfer case noise in 4WD, usually within the first month (~682 miles). The fix is a new input gear and input seal in the NV241 GenII; don't try to reseat a dislodged input gear cap plug.

applies.engine: Rock-Trac HD part-time 4WD transfer case, 4:1 (sales code DHW)

specs.name: Built
specs.value: November 25, 2015 (MDH 1125XX) through August 10, 2016 (MDH 0810XX), sales code DHW

specs.name: Typical onset
specs.value: Under one month in service, average 1,097 km (682 mi)

steps.text: Check the VIN against the RRT 17-027 list; listed vehicles get the repair.
If the input gear cap plug is dislodged, out of position or loose, don't try to fix or refit it. That won't fix the leak and it will come back.
Remove the transfer case (NV241 GenII), replace the input gear and input seal, and reinstall it per the service manual.

sources.title: Service Bulletin 21-012-17: Transfer Case Input Seal Leak
